subject: Wish for standard acronym-tag use in all widget elements

messages.author: fd98f08a6ab27905
messages.subject: Wish for standard acronym-tag use in all widget elements
parts:
Hi,

I recently leaned that HTML offers the option to present some additional text information on an element as soon as you hover the mouse over it (via the "acronym" tag).

Wouldn't it be nice to implement this to all shiny elements to give additional information to users of shiny apps?

Example:

checkboxInput("mycb", "Want to check me?", usernote = "By checking this box, you can demonstrate you will to check this box.")

The usernote-argument could be standard for all shiny-elements.

Best,
WF

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Wish for standard acronym-tag use in all widget elements
parts:
I think this might have the same effect:

tags$div(title="By checking this box, you can demonstrate you willto check this box.",
  checkboxInput("mycb", "Want to check me?"))
